name: comms-mcp
description: Unified fleet comms gateway: Telegram, WhatsApp, Slack and Teams behind one comms_ops MCP tool. Allowlist-gated send, sanitized inbound, 7-day retention.

tools.name: comms_ops
tools.description: Send, read, list, status, auth and help across Telegram, WhatsApp, Slack and Teams (operation=..., channel=...).

tools.name: comms_shutdown
tools.description: Orderly shutdown of the HTTP daemon (confirm=True); flushes the SQLite outbox before exit.

tools.name: comms_show_status
tools.description: Prefab status card: per-channel configured/health plus outbox and retention stats.
